# fptcloud_database_restore_points (Data Source)

Lists the restore points (backups) of a FPT Cloud database cluster.

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Id of the database cluster.
- `restore_points` (List of Object) Restore points, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restore_points))

<a id="nestedatt--restore_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restore_points`

Read-Only:

- `backup_part` (String)
- `backup_size` (String)
- `backup_state` (String) `successful` when the restore point can be restored.
- `backup_type` (String)
- `finish_time` (String)
- `start_time` (String)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_database_restore_points" "db" {
  cluster_id = "owiiqtii"
}

output "restore_points" {
  value = [for p in data.fptcloud_database_restore_points.db.restore_points : p.backup_part if p.backup_state == "successful"]
}
```
